description: Set which of the tenant's mailboxes belong to an agent and which one is its default (admins and planners only). Required: agent_id, email_account_ids (ids from list_mailboxes; an empty list clears the setting). Optional: standard = one of email_account_ids (with exactly one id it is the default by itself). Afterwards fetch_inbox, list_emails and the mail-folder tools use the default when this agent acts and no email_account_id is given, list_mailboxes shows only these mailboxes to the agent, and get_agent_bootstrap lists them. It only narrows — it grants no read access the caller does not already have.

grund.description: Why (goes into the optimisation register, list_optimierungen)

standard.description: Default mailbox id, must be in email_account_ids
